title: What Are the World's Happiest Destinations?
paragraphs: Have you ever traveled somewhere that just made you feel ... happy? Like your shoulders dropped two inches the moment you arrived, and you couldn't stop smiling? Well, according to new research, there's one place that makes people feel this way better than anywhere else.
Tulum, a beach town by the Caribbean Sea in Mexico, has been named the happiest travel destination in the world.

Travel company JustCover looked at over 1 million online reviews of places like tourist sites, hotels and natural areas across 155 destinations. The company then checked how often visitors used language showing happiness and joy — phrases like "this place made me so happy" — and used that to give each place a score from 0 to 100, with the top destination set at 100.
And Tulum came out on top. Known for its white-sand beaches, clear blue water and ancient Mayan ruins, it has lots of things that make travelers smile.
Second place went to another Caribbean town: Soufrière in Saint Lucia. It sits near the Pitons, two large volcanic peaks, and is also known for its beaches, hot springs and beautiful scenery.
Not all of the happiest places were beach towns, though. Oaxaca, a city in Mexico, took third place. The city is famous for its history, colorful streets, markets and its food.
And big cities made the list too, including Las Vegas in fourth and New York City in sixth.
JustCover also made a separate European list, with Positano in Italy taking first place, followed by Santorini in Greece and Kotor in Montenegro.
So, which of these places would put the biggest smile on your face?
